title: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Terms: First Covered Day of Rideshare, Taxi and Transit
content:
**Terms.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the first covered rideshare day of a rideshare authorization depends on how the loss left the vehicle. It is determined from the claim report on the Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim and from the customer's Cardinal Roadside Assistance service calls.

(a) **Total theft.** Where the cause of loss on the claim report is a total theft, the first covered rideshare day is the option's theft waiting days, in calendar days, after the claim's report date. That is 1 day after the report date on 30/900, 40/1200 and 50/1500, and the report date itself (0 days) on 60/1800, 75/2250 and 100/3000.

(b) **Vehicle not drivable, or accident tow moved to the claim.** Where the cause of loss is anything other than a total theft, the first covered rideshare day is the claim's report date in either of these cases:
- the claim report records the vehicle as not drivable; or
- an accident tow was moved from roadside assistance to the claim. This shows as a Cardinal Roadside Assistance service call restored for the reason that the accident tow was moved to the claim.

(c) **Any other case.** The first covered rideshare day is the start date of the rideshare authorization.

The covered rideshare days are counted from the first covered rideshare day through the last covered rideshare day, both included, and are never fewer than zero. The first covered day may fall before the authorization's start date.

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

| Claim report | Roadside record | Report date | Rideshare authorization | First covered rideshare day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Total theft, on 40/1200 | — | May 3 | Starts May 5 | May 4 |
| Total theft, on 75/2250 | — | May 3 | Starts May 5 | May 3 |
| Collision, not drivable | — | May 3 | Starts May 5 | May 3 |
| Collision, drivable | Tow restored as moved to the claim | May 3 | Starts May 5 | May 3 |
| Hail, drivable | None | May 3 | Starts May 5 | May 5 |

In the third case the rideshare authorization closes with an end date of May 9. The covered rideshare days run from May 3 through May 9, which is 7 days.
